query: For positive natural denominators r and natural finitely supported exponents d, sum of real d j / r j is zero iff d is zero

items.name: Finsupp.weight_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M]
  [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] (w : σ → M) [Finsupp.NonTorsionWeight ℕ w] {f : σ →₀ ℕ}, (Finsupp.weight w) f = 0 ↔ f = 0

items.name: Finsupp.add_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd α]
  (f g : ι →₀ α), f + g = 0 ↔ f = 0 ∧ g = 0

items.name: Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd R]
  (d : σ →₀ R), Finsupp.degree d = 0 ↔ d = 0

items.name: DFinsupp.add_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (α i)] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → PartialOrder (α i)]
  [∀ (i : ι), CanonicallyOrderedAdd (α i)] (f g : Π₀ (i : ι), α i), f + g = 0 ↔ f = 0 ∧ g = 0

items.name: Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι}
  [AddLeftMono N], (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) → (∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0)

items.name: DFinsupp.sum_eq_zero
Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} [Subsingleton (AddUnits M)],
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0

items.name: ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ENNReal}, ∑' (i : α), f i = 0 ↔ ∀ (i : α), f i = 0
